claims.reason: Searched the whole Regulation text for app, permission, device, telephone and Android wording, and the Android article region (4276 of 6655 characters kept) for consent, RODO, personal data and processing. The Android region never mentions consent or data protection (only menu names such as Prywatność). The Regulation never mentions app permissions or Android. Nearest text: recital 32 (line 369) lists choosing technical settings of an information society service as one possible form of consent when the context clearly shows acceptance; it does not say when an app permission is such a choice.

claims.reason: Searched the text of art. 7 (lines 2490-2513) for any rule on when a service must stay available after consent is refused. Art. 7 ust. 4 only names the conditioning of a contract or service on unnecessary consent as a factor to be taken into account to the greatest extent. Note: recital 43 (lines 515-518) is firmer than art. 7 ust. 4: it says consent is not regarded as voluntary if performance of a contract, including a service, is made conditional on consent that is not necessary for it. The absence holds for art. 7 ust. 4 itself, not for the recital.

scope_gaps.note: The claim speaks of a system permission in general; the only source is the Android help page, so other operating systems are not covered.
The minimisation duty binds the controller (administrator), not the app user; the sentence does not say who is bound and a reader might assume the user is.

notes: No protocol violation: I opened only AGENTS.md, the role file, the packet and the two listed snapshots (89be0046cf8ac2b2.txt, 96ed8430ad13bbdc.txt). Both snapshots are readable and are the documents they should be. UODO file is the Regulation (UE) 2016/679 as first published in the Official Journal of 4.5.2016, not a consolidated version; claims were checked against that text only. Android snapshot is only the article region (4276 of 6655 chars). The 'Google' attribution in Korzyść i dowody#4 rests on the URL domain only. Article and point references (art. 4 pkt 11, art. 6 ust. 1, art. 7 ust. 4) are filed as meta_statement cross-references and split out of their sentences, because the single digit in a short heading line cannot be quoted; I checked the article headings in the snapshot (Artykuł 4 line 2215 Definicje, Artykuł 6 line 2412, Artykuł 7 line 2490). Nearby texts the editors may want to weigh: recital 32 (line 369) for Ograniczenia#2.2 and recital 43 (lines 515-518) for Ograniczenia#4.3. The only quote that previously failed (W praktyce#3, recital 42, line 506) is now taken from single lines 506 and 507 without joining the hyphenated word across lines.
